audit.why: Chart already matches: Swain L1/L2, Rell L3, Rell 4-5, Swain L6, Rell 1st item, Rell 2+ items in both phases[].side (full) and win[] (content) — consistent, matches the packet levelChart and the 54.74% Swain-favoured overall WR with Rell clawing back mid-late.

Spikes already correctly flag level 6 as a Swain spike (Demonic Ascension sustain) and first item as Rell's spike (outlasting the drain) — matches real kit (R cd 120 flat, no rank scaling shown beyond that).

audit.whatIsWrong: Multiple fields mislabel Swain's abilities: 'Nevermove W' (Nevermove is his E, not W), 'Death's Hand E' (Death's Hand is his Q, not E), and describe 'Vision of Empire pull'/'pull with ult' when the root-and-pull is entirely Nevermove (E) — Vision of Empire (W) only slows/reveals, and the ult (R) drains/slows, it does not pull.
audit.why: enemyAbilities in the brief confirms slots directly: Q=Death's Hand, W=Vision of Empire, E=Nevermove, R=Demonic Ascension. The kit text for E explicitly says Nevermove roots on return and Swain 'can then choose to pull all rooted champions closer' — the pull is E's, not W's or R's. This is the same class of error as the Brand R / Cassiopeia Q calibration examples.
audit.corrected: See edits to whys[1], spikes[0].text, early, mid, wants.foe[1].

edits.before: Swain wins level 2 because his Nevermove root plus ult pull punish your short engage range.
edits.after: Swain wins level 2 because his Nevermove E roots and pulls, punishing your short engage range.

edits.before: Swain out-trades you early: his Nevermove W and Vision of Empire pull, plus Death's Hand E poke, punish you before you have your full combo, and every point of health you lose feeds his passive Soul Fragment healing. Don't walk into his W root range at 1-2.
edits.after: Swain out-trades you early: his Nevermove E roots and pulls you in, and Death's Hand Q poke punishes you before you have your full combo — every point of health you lose feeds his passive Soul Fragment healing. Don't walk into his E root range at 1-2.

edits.before: Swain wins the early lane: his Death's Hand E chunks you, and if you facecheck his Nevermove W root he pulls with Vision of Empire and free-heals off your health via Soul Fragments. At 1-2 respect his root range and don't feed the trade — poke minions, hold your engage, and wait for a mistake.
edits.after: Swain wins the early lane: his Death's Hand Q chunks you, and if you facecheck his Nevermove E he roots and pulls you in, then free-heals off your health via Soul Fragments. At 1-2 respect his root range and don't feed the trade — poke minions, hold your engage, and wait for a mistake.

edits.before: You take over at 3-5 once your combo is online: bait or wait out his W root, then W-Q into E stun so he can't kite, and your bulk beats his mana-limited poke. The moment his Nevermove is on cooldown he has no escape and no self-peel, so that's your all-in window every wave.
edits.after: You take over at 3-5 once your combo is online: bait or wait out his E root, then W-Q into E stun so he can't kite, and your bulk beats his mana-limited poke. The moment his Nevermove is on cooldown he has no escape and no self-peel, so that's your all-in window every wave.

edits.before: Land Nevermove W root to lock your engage and pull with ult
edits.after: Land Nevermove E to root and pull your engage into range

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Eat Death's Hand poke mounted, where your armour and MR hold — dismount only once Nevermove is spent.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Trading chip damage into an unspent Nevermove is how you get rooted, pulled, and finished off.

edits.before: - Swain Nevermove: matchup-defining — The root that decides — dodge it and the general farms regret. It writes your spacing rules. - E Full Tilt (remount speed) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Nevermove is 12-10s on Swain, shorter still during Demonic Ascension — dodge it, the root-and-pull decides fights. - Your own E is 14-10s, use it to reset autos in chains. - His R Ascension is 120s flat — pick one all-in per cast.

notes: Ability-slot mixup found and fixed: 'Nevermove W' and 'Vision of Empire pull' were both wrong — Nevermove is Swain's E and it owns both the root and the pull; Death's Hand is his Q, not E. Fixed across whys[1], spikes[0].text, early, mid, and wants.foe[1]. Left whys[0]/mid's other W/E references alone where they were already correct (e.g. Rell's own 'W-Q into E stun' is Rell's kit, unaffected). No missing-antiheal or resistances-invalidated edit added separately — report[8].t itemization already says 'Add anti-heal early into his duo's sustain' (pronoun correct here, Swain is male) which covers the needs-antiheal interaction; the resistances-invalidated one (Ravenous Flock % health) isn't mentioned anywhere and is a genuine gap, flagged here rather than invented into a field without room in the length band.
